rationale: In the middle campaign, the incumbent-to-GP-maximum gap is 2.14, median uncertainty is 1.80, 121 scaffolds have been observed, the last batch mean was 7.75. This supports a mixed batch with an exploration majority while preserving the available hedge channels.
expected_outcome: The batch will have a mean affinity of at least 7.0 and add at least 4 new scaffolds.
